item.title: Poor blood circulation crisis: Do you know the signs?
item.description: Some people are more prone to circulation disorders. These include people with diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, smoking habits, and a sedentary lifestyle. Also, older people are more prone to circulation disorders since their blood vessels naturally lose elasticity with age.

item.title: Bill Gates to attend AI Impact Summit 2026, Gates Foundation dismisses no-show rumours
item.description: Bill Gates will attend the AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, the Gates Foundation has confirmed. The Foundation dismissed reports claiming he would skip the event, calling those rumours untrue.

item.title: Victims of RAMmageddon: PS6, laptops, smartphones, cars, who suffers
item.description: A global DRAM shortage in 2026 is disrupting production across gaming, smartphones, cars and EVs. AI data centers led by Nvidia and major tech firms are consuming massive amounts of memory, pushing up prices and squeezing supply. Industry leaders warn the crunch may worsen in the coming months.

item.title: China could be banning the ‘Yoke’ steering wheel next
item.description: China is reportedly looking to ban the ‘Yoke’ style steering as well from January 1st, 2027. This coincides with the brand banning the hidden electric door handles.

item.title: NASA preps for second wet dress rehearsal of Artemis II on 19 Feb
item.description: NASA is targeting Thursday, 19 February for the second Wet Dress Rehearsal. March 6 is the earliest opportunity to launch the crewed mission to the Moon.

item.title: Feeling tired or stressed? Swami Ramdev explains why morning Pranayama can help
item.description: Pranayama is an important part of the Indian yoga tradition as it helps to balance both body and mind. Find out how adopting some of the pranayama exercises recommended by yoga guru Swami Ramdev can be beneficial for your health.

item.title: Astronomers looking for aliens spot pulsar in heart of Milky Way
item.description: Astronomers have discovered a pulsar at the core of the Milky Way. It is close to the supermassive black hole, Sagittarius A*.

item.title: Yuvraj Samra: Named after Yuvraj Singh, Canada youngster scripts T20 World Cup history with special century
item.description: 19-year-old teen sensation Yuvraj Samra emulated his namesake and idol Yuvraj Singh with a record-breaking century in the T20 World Cup 2026 clash against New Zealand in Chennai.

item.title: Residential colonies flooded after Singur-Hyderabad water pipeline bursts in Manikonda
item.description: The incident occurred at about 2.30 am, resulting in heavy inflow of water into low-lying areas, especially in Shivasai colony and Employees colony.

item.title: Surya Grahan: Why solar eclipse doesn’t happen every month
item.description: A solar eclipse does not occur every month despite the Moon’s regular orbit. Here is a clear explanation of orbital tilt, alignment and eclipse seasons.
